verdict.rationale: Washington DOR publishes plain-language, click-by-click walkthroughs for filing excise tax returns in My DOR (adding deductions, requesting penalty waivers, choosing payment, amending). It also gives a step-by-step license application path with processing times, a Business Licensing Wizard with helpful tips, and free workshops and webinars on tax responsibilities. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that non-lawyers find the guidance followable, and evidence of plain-language explainers on tax obligations themselves (B&O guidance largely points to rate lists).

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers

citations.quote: If you have deductions, click the Add Deduction button. Select the deduction type and enter the amount.
To request a penalty waiver, first click the Request Penalty Waiver checkbox. Then, select if you would like to be considered for a 24 month waiver
Complete the Business Licensing Wizard to receive a list of agencies to contact, additional endorsements and helpful tips about your business license.
Attend a free in-person workshop or online webinar to learn about your Washington state tax reporting responsibilities.
